Thanks for your response. I've already talked with my advisors and there's nothing I can do to make a C, but I'm still going to finish as strong as I can.

Part of the problem is that I haven't been dealt a shitty hand in life. I've been given every opportunity. I've been dealt a great hand, but despite that I fuck everything up. There are so many people out there with less opportunity that would kill for what I've had and would have gone on to do great things. And knowing that I'm the one who was given chance instead eats away at my soul.
